About this Event

✨ ONE NIGHT. FOUR YEARS OF MEMORIES. A NEW YEAR TO CELEBRATE! ✨
Welcome 2027 with your favorite people, your favorite South Indian beats, and a dance floor ready for celebration!
MSE Production House invites you to celebrate our 4th anniversary at a special South Indian New Year’s Eve Party in Somerset, New Jersey.
Whether you’re coming with your party crew, celebrating as a couple, or gathering your friends for one last night out in 2026, get ready for a night of Tollywood and Kollywood music, dancing, and New Year energy.
🎶 THE SOUNDTRACK TO YOUR NEW YEAR
Bring your best moves for a night of Telugu and Tamil favorites, DJ beats, and dhol energy. From songs you can sing along to with your friends to tracks that bring everyone onto the dance floor, this is your night to celebrate.
🎉 WHAT TO LOOK FORWARD TO
• Tollywood & Kollywood music
• DJ entertainment and dhol
• Food and drinks available
• A special guest appearance
• VIP experience options
• MSE Production House’s 4th anniversary celebration
• A festive setting to welcome 2027 with your crew
📍 EVENT DETAILS
Date: Thursday, December 31, 2026
Venue: Clarion Hotel – Somerset Ballroom
Address: 60 Cottontail Lane, Somerset, NJ 08873

Gather your friends, plan your New Year’s Eve, and book your tickets. Check your selected ticket description for admission details and any included benefits.
